No. 2003/2 – MONDAY, JANUARY, 23, 2017
EXTRAORDINARY
THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Notice Under Section 7
My No.: KDS/UDP/4/1/LAQ/Mor/Pro/Re/38(1).
Land Ministry’s No.: 4-3/5/2015/CEB/119. The land Acquisition for Construction of Reservor Dam, Power house and Switch Yard of Hydro Power Project of Moragolla, Gampola.

I hereby give notice, under Sub-section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, as amended by the Land Acquisition (Amendment) Act, No. 28 of 1964, that the Government intends to acquire the following land/servitude which is required for a public purpose.

Description of the Land or servitude to be acquired : The land allotments called Atabagewatta, Sooriyagodawatta, Galathawatta in Total Extent of about 4.1529 and 4.9296 Hectares, shown as Lot No. 129-135 and Lot 28-34 in Cadastral Map No. 320088(3) 5 and 320229(5) 2 depicted and prepared by Surveyor General situated in the Grama Niladhari Division of Kekulanda and Galatha in KandukaraIhalakorale in Divisional Secretary’s Division of Udapalatha in Kandy District, Central Province.

All persons interested in the aforesaid land/Lands on which a servitude is to be acquired are hereby required to appear personally, or by agents duly authorized in writing, before me at Divisional Secretariat of Udapalatha on the 13th March 2017 at 10.30 and are hereby requested to notify to me in writing (in duplicate) on or before the 27th February 2017 the nature of their interests in the land, the practiculars of their claims for compensation and the acquisition of the said land/servitude for the amount of compensation and the details of the computation of such amount. U. P. INDIKA ANURUDDHA PIYADASA, Divisional Secretary, Udapalatha Division, Gampola. Divisional Secretariat, Udapalatha. 20th January, 2017.
